title: Agent Framework Core
summary: This module defines the foundational components for building and running AI agents, including their abstract interface, configuration, and the graph-based execution flow for processing user prompts and tool calls.

nodes.label: Define Agent Interface
nodes.title: AbstractAgent
nodes.description: Abstract base class defining the core interface and common methods for all agents, including running, streaming, and configuration overrides.

nodes.label: Wrap Another Agent
nodes.title: WrapperAgent
nodes.description: An agent implementation that delegates all its functionality to an underlying wrapped AbstractAgent, useful for extending or modifying agent behavior.

nodes.label: Process User Input & Instructions
nodes.title: UserPromptNode
nodes.description: Manages the initial user prompt, instructions, and system prompts, preparing messages for the model or handling deferred tool results.

nodes.label: Execute Agent Tool
nodes.title: _call_tool
nodes.description: Executes a specific tool call, processing its arguments and handling various result types, including retries and denials.

nodes.label: Process Tool Call Outcome
nodes.title: handle_call_or_result
nodes.description: Handles the asynchronous result of a tool call, capturing successful returns, deferred calls, or approval requirements.

nodes.label: Manage Run Message History
nodes.title: capture_run_messages
nodes.description: Provides a context manager to access and manage the message history exchanged during an agent's run, useful for debugging and error handling.

nodes.label: Instantiate Agent Capability
nodes.title: _instantiate_cap
nodes.description: Validates and instantiates an agent capability class from provided arguments and keyword arguments.

nodes.label: Define Agent Configuration
nodes.title: AgentSpec
nodes.description: Pydantic model for defining an agent's configuration from external sources like YAML or JSON, including model, instructions, and capabilities.

nodes.label: Save Agent Spec Schema
nodes.title: _save_schema
nodes.description: Saves the JSON schema for an AgentSpec to a file, including details about custom capability types.

nodes.label: Resolve Capability Schema Target
nodes.title: _get_schema_target
nodes.description: Determines the appropriate method (__init__ or from_spec) to use for resolving type hints when building schemas for capabilities.

nodes.label: LLM Model Abstraction
nodes.title: Model Abstraction
nodes.description: Provides an abstract interface for interacting with various Large Language Models.

nodes.label: Agent Capabilities & Tools
nodes.title: Capabilities & Tools
nodes.description: Defines the framework for agent capabilities, tool management, and tool execution.

nodes.label: Core Utility Functions
nodes.title: Core Utilities
nodes.description: Contains general utility functions like event loop management and context handling.

groups.label: Agent Core
groups.title: Agent Core Components
groups.description: Fundamental classes that define what an AI agent is and how it can be extended or wrapped.

groups.label: Agent Graph Processing
groups.title: Agent Graph Execution Flow
groups.description: Components responsible for processing user input, managing the agent's conversational flow, and executing tools within the agent's operational graph.

groups.label: Agent Configuration
groups.title: Agent Specification and Schema
groups.description: Components related to defining, loading, and validating agent configurations from structured formats.

groups.label: Internal Utilities
groups.title: Internal Helper Functions
groups.description: Helper functions that support various aspects of agent operation, such as message history management and capability instantiation.
